title: Partner / Cloud Marketplace Weekly Sync - prep & follow-ups
content:
Meeting: Partner / Cloud Marketplace weekly sync (internal prep)
Date: 2026-03-03 10:00 PT (sync w/ AWS/Azure/GCP reps)
Owner: Jamie Park (lead)
Attendees (invited): Sam Brooks (AWS PM), Leila Hassan (Azure GTM), Miguel Torres (GCP Partner), Tanya Rao (Channel partner lead), Alex Kim (sales ops), Priya Desai (rev ops)

PURPOSE: quick status check across marketplace onboarding, billing/metering, packaging templates, and co-marketing timelines. Surface blockers and align on next milestones.

AGENDA (25 min):
1) Quick updates (2 min each partner) - current stage, outstanding asks
2) Billing & metering follow-up (5 min) - AWS consumption reports, Azure usage meter mapping, GCP credits flow
3) Deployment templates & marketplace listings (5 min) - ARM/Helm templates, listing assets (images/docs), S3/publication cadence
4) GTM & co-marketing (5 min) - joint webinars, marketplace featured spots, PR timeline
5) Blockers & escalations (5 min) - legal/compliance, pricing alignment, technical validation windows

PREP NOTES / QUICK STATUS
- AWS (Sam): onboarding checklist mostly green. Need final support matrix doc for their listing (they want it by 3/10). AWS legal requested SOC2 attestation snippet - we can provide excerpt but Legal asked for a one-pager first.
  - Open: confirm SOC2 excerpt content (JIRA-4521 assigned to Legal: Priya).
  - Tech: consumption meter integration tests passing in staging; still flaky on burst scenarios (ticket in infra: #56).

- Azure (Leila): marketplace listing draft ready; publishing window target week of 3/22. They want a quick partner quote and 1-2 screenshots of console flows. Ask: do we have approved screenshots? (Quick win: use dev console mockups + watermark).
  - Open: get approved screenshots + product quote (owner: Jamie / due 3/09).

- GCP (Miguel): alpha listing accepted but needs deployment template for private deployments (VPC + KMS guidance). GCP asks for a short architecture diagram and network requirements doc.
  - Open: create 1-page network requirements and diagram (owner: Carlos, due 3/11).

- Channel partners (Tanya): partner enablement deck draft is ~60% done. Wants a short tech checklist for partners + 2-page playbook for sales engineers.
  - Open: finalize partner playbook skeleton (owner: Alex, due 3/16).

BILLING & METERING (notes):
- AWS: consumption reports look good; want to validate billing CSV fields mapping. Action: Priya to validate sample CSV against our invoicing pipeline (due 3/06).
- Azure: using marketplace metering service; need to map 'units' -> token counts approximation (delicate). Need an internal doc describing token->unit conversion and rounding rules (owner: Jamie / due 3/09).
- GCP: credits vs billing reconciliation to be confirmed; Miguel will share sample billing export post-meeting.

DEPLOYMENT / LISTING ASSETS:
- Templates: Helm + k8s manifest examples are in GH PR #56 (linked). Need to confirm license header and example env var secrets redaction.
- Screenshots: product UI screenshots - use dev console mockups, watermark with 'preview'. Legal to review marketing assets (Priya).

GTM / CO-MARKETING:
- Joint webinar: target April 14. Confirm speakers and run-through timing. Action: Jamie to propose 2 speaker combos by 3/05.
- Marketplace featured spot: Azure targeting editorial slot for April; need final listing by 3/22.

BLOCKERS / RISKS:
- SOC2 excerpt: Legal needs to draft quick one-pager. If delayed > 3/10, AWS listing will be delayed.
- Metering conversion risks: if the token->unit mapping is off, partners may dispute usage; need clear rounding rules and sample invoices.
- Staging flakiness (burst traffic): infra ticket #56 must land soak tests before 3/20 or we risk failing partner validation.

PREP QUESTIONS (to ask partners):
- For AWS: do they require additional observability hooks (CloudWatch metric names) embedded in documentation?
- For Azure: confirm the acceptance criteria for screenshots - do they prefer high-fidelity or annotated wireframes?
- For GCP: clarify expectations for private deployment docs (level of network detail, sample terraform?).

POST-MEETING FOLLOW-UPS (to send within 24h):
- Draft note templates: (1) Thank you + agreed milestones; (2) Action item summary table; (3) Request for any missing artifacts (SOC2, screenshots).
- Assign action items in JIRA and share board link.

ACTION ITEMS (quick table):
- Priya Desai: Draft SOC2 excerpt one-pager for AWS (JIRA-4521). Due: 2026-03-10.
- Jamie Park: Produce token->unit conversion doc for Azure; propose webinar speaker combos; send screenshots to Legal. Due: 2026-03-09 (doc), 2026-03-05 (speakers).
- Carlos Mendez: Produce 1-page network requirements + diagram for GCP private deployment. Due: 2026-03-11.
- Alex Kim: Finalize partner playbook skeleton and coordinate SE review. Due: 2026-03-16.
- Infra (owner TBD / pinged): Resolve staging burst flakiness; complete soak tests. Target: 2026-03-20.
- Sam (AWS): confirm if CloudWatch metrics naming needed and share sampling window requirements. Due: 2026-03-06.

NOTES TO SELF:
- Keep the meeting tight (25 min) - watch for long Azure/GCP dives. If deep technical items come up, suggest follow-up breakout with SRE/infra.
- Bring up the invoice sample during billing discussion - show one mock CSV so Priya can sign off quickly.
- Save time at end for 'asks from partners' so they feel heard - quick commitment is better than vague promises.

DRAFT POST-MEETING EMAIL (copy)
Subject: Follow-up + action items from Marketplace Weekly (3/3)
Hi team,
Thanks for the sync. Summary + action items below. Please confirm owners/due dates and ping if anything missing.
[insert action item table from above]
Link to board: https://jira.redwood/browse/boards/marketplace-onboarding
Cheers,
Jamie

REFERENCES / LINKS I MAY NEED DURING MEETING:
- GH PR for templates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-infra/pull/56
- JIRA-4521 (SOC2 excerpt)
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/partner-marketplace-onboarding
- Slack partner thread: #partners (pinned messages)

TODO (personal):
- Print quick checklist before call (1-pager): agenda, 3 quick asks, 2 screenshots, mock invoice.
- Prep 2 slide snippets for co-marketing ask (1 slide: value props; 1 slide: customer story).

END OF NOTE
